subject: Stream/Funcall compatibility matrix + proposed SDK patch plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@medsprint.com>, Nina Park <nina.park@medsprint.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stream/Funcall compatibility matrix + proposed SDK patch plan

Hi Avery / Nina — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our side and clear next steps so we all have the same playbook.

Pain points you flagged
- Latency spikes on long conversational sessions when reranking embeddings for triage results (especially during peak hours).
- Existing inference stack requires multiple round trips for function-call style extractions (named entities -> structured JSON) which increases p99.
- Need for deterministic structured outputs for downstream EHR ingestion (fixed schema).

Goal you outlined
- Single-call streaming response that can simultaneously: stream partial text, emit structured JSON when function patterns are satisfied, and provide an embedding snapshot for immediate rerank — all within a 300ms median token latency target for short queries.

What we propose (high level)
1) Adapter compatibility matrix: we mapped MedSprint’s pipeline (current model variants, tokenizer setup, and rolling cache TTL) against our runtime’s streaming+funcall capability. See attached adapter_compat_matrix.csv for the full mapping; short story: two of your model variants need a small tokenizer-config tweak and one requires a KV-cache affinity change.
2) Minimal SDK patch: a light-weight patch to the Python and Node SDKs that surfaces a new StreamingFuncCallHandler and exposes hooks for structured schema validation and onEmitEmbedding callbacks. This is intended as a backwards-compatible opt-in patch (no breaking changes).
3) POC approach: 2-week pilot where we run your triage workload against a dedicated test pool with prefix-caching enabled and the SDK patch applied. We’ll measure p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost delta, and embedding recall for your reranker.

Immediate next steps
- We’ll drop the adapter matrix + SDK patch draft into the Google Doc tonight. (attachment: streaming-funcall-proposal.pdf)
- Ben will sketch the ops runbook for the pilot and share the infra checklist.
- Proposed technical deep-dive: Tue 4/13 10:00 AM PT — please confirm.

Avery / Nina: can you confirm which dataset subset you want us to use for the pilot (sample size, timeframe) and whether you need HIPAA BAAs in place before we spin up the test pool?

Thanks — Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@medsprint.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@medsprint.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stream/Funcall compatibility matrix + proposed SDK patch plan

Thanks Jasmine — this aligns with our notes. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot dataset: use anonymized triage logs for March-April (we'll provide the CSV subset; target ~10k sessions).
- BAA: yes, we'll need the HIPAA BAA signed before any production-equivalent data is used. For the initial test pool we can start with fully anonymized data while legal completes the BAA.
- Deep-dive: Tue 4/13 10:00 AM PT works for our engineering leads.

Also: would like to see the expected failure modes for the StreamingFuncCallHandler (e.g., partial structured emits, schema mismatches) and how the SDK surfaces fallbacks so we can map to our ingestion retries.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. —Avery

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Collins <avery.collins@medsprint.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stream/Funcall compatibility matrix + proposed SDK patch plan

Looping in some ops/infra notes so expectations are clear. Short tech notes: 

- The tokenizer tweak Jasmine mentioned is a single flag switch (preserve_special_tokens=False) that avoids re-tokenizing prefix context during streaming. Low risk.
- KV-cache affinity: we recommend pinning the pilot's test pool to a single GPU rack for the first run to avoid cold cache churn — we'll document the cost delta in the runbook.
- Failure modes: SDK will expose an onSchemaMismatch hook and a fallback path that emits the raw text plus an error code. For streaming partial emits, we’ll include sequence tokens with timestamps so your ingestion can assemble and perform idempotent inserts.

Attachments: sdk_patch_plan.md — draft of the patch and upgrade steps. adapter_compat_matrix.csv — link to the compatibility table.

Action items I’ll handle:
- Finalize the infra checklist and estimate for a 2-week pilot by end of day Mon 4/12.
- Create a read-only demo environment and temporary credentials with limited data access.

Ben

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
